# PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS] Contents of this Part

## Types of claim in which Part 8 procedure is used

## 8.1

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.1] (1) The Part 8 procedure is the procedure set out in this Part.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.1] (2) A claimant may, unless any enactment, rule or practice direction states otherwise, use the Part 8 procedure where they seek the court’s decision on a question which is unlikely to involve a substantial dispute of fact.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.1] (3) In the County Court, a claim under the Part 8 procedure may be made at any County Court hearing centre unless an enactment, rule or practice direction states otherwise.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.1] (4) The court may at any stage order the claim to continue as if the claimant had not used the Part 8 procedure and, if it does so, the court may give any directions it considers appropriate.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.1] (5) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure, they may not obtain default judgment under Part 12.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.1] (6) A rule or practice direction may, in relation to a specified type of proceedings, disapply or modify any of the rules set out in this Part as they apply to those proceedings.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.1] (Rule 8.9 provides for other modifications to the general rules where the Part 8 procedure is being used.)

## Contents of the claim form

## 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (a) that this Part applies;

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (b)

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (i) the question which the claimant wants the court to decide; or

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (ii) the remedy which the claimant is seeking and the legal basis for the claim to that remedy;

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (c) if the claim is being made under an enactment, what that enactment is;

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (d) if the claimant is claiming in a representative capacity, what that capacity is; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (e) if the defendant is sued in a representative capacity, what that capacity is.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (Part 22 provides for the claim form to be verified by a statement of truth)

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2 (1) Where the claimant uses the Part 8 procedure the claim form must state –] (2) Except where another rule or practice direction applies, rule 7.5 and rule 7.6 shall apply with regard to the service of the claim form.

## Issue of claim form without naming defendants

## 8.2A

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2A] (1) A practice direction may set out circumstances in which a claim form may be issued under this Part without naming a defendant.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2A] (2) The practice direction may set out those cases in which an application for permission must be made by application notice before the claim form is issued.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2A] (3) The application notice for permission –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2A] (a) need not be served on any other person; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2A] (b) must be accompanied by a copy of the claim form that the applicant proposes to issue.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.2A] (4) Where the court gives permission it will give directions about the future management of the claim.

## Acknowledgment of service

## 8.3

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (1) The defendant must –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (a) file an acknowledgment of service in the relevant practice form not more than 14 days after service of the claim form; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (b) serve the acknowledgment of service on the claimant and any other party.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (2) The acknowledgment of service must state –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (a) whether the defendant contests the claim; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (b) if the defendant seeks a different remedy from that set out in the claim form, what that remedy is.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (3) The following rules of Part 10 (acknowledgment of service) apply –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (a) rule 10.3(2) (exceptions to the period for filing an acknowledgment of service); and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (b) rule 10.5 (contents of acknowledgment of service).

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.3] (4) Omitted

## Consequence of not filing an acknowledgment of service

## 8.4

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.4] (1) This rule applies where –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.4] (a) the defendant has failed to file an acknowledgment of service; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.4] (b) the time period for doing so has expired.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.4] (2) The defendant may attend the hearing of the claim but may not take part in the hearing unless the court gives permission.

## Filing and serving written evidence

## 8.5

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (1) When the claimant files the claim form, they must also file any written evidence on which they intend to rely.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (2) The claimant must serve their written evidence on the defendant with the claim form.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (3) A defendant who wishes to rely on written evidence must file it when they file their acknowledgment of service unless the defendant has indicated on their acknowledgement of service an intention to contest jurisdiction, in which case the evidence must be filed within fourteen days of filing the acknowledgment of service if no such application is made.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (4) If a defendant files their evidence, they must also, at the same time, serve a copy of their evidence on the other parties.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (5) The claimant may, within 14 days of service of the defendant’s evidence on them, file further written evidence in reply.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (6) If they do so, they must also, within the same time limit, serve a copy of their evidence on the other parties.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (7) The claimant may rely on the matters set out in the claim form as evidence under this rule if the claim form is verified by a statement of truth.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (8) A party may apply to the court for an extension of time to serve and file evidence or for permission to serve and file additional evidence under rule 8.6(1).

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (9) The parties may agree in writing on an extension of time of not more than 14 days for serving and filing evidence from the defendant and of not more than 28 days for serving and filing evidence in reply.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.5] (10) Any such agreement must be filed with the court with the acknowledgement of service or, if it relates to evidence in reply, within 48 hours of the agreement.

## Evidence – general

## 8.6

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.6] (1) No written evidence may be relied on at the hearing of the claim unless –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.6] (a) it has been served in accordance with rule 8.5; or

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.6] (b) the court gives permission.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.6] (2) The court may require or permit a party to give oral evidence at the hearing.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.6] (3) The court may give directions requiring the attendance for cross-examination ( GL ) of a witness who has given written evidence.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.6] (Rule 32.1 contains a general power for the court to control evidence)

## Counterclaims and other additional claims

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > Counterclaims and other additional claims] 8.7 Where the Part 8 procedure is used, Part 20 (counterclaims and other additional claims) applies except that a party may not make a counterclaim or other additional claim (as defined by rule 20.2) without the court’s permission.

## Procedure where defendant objects to use of the Part 8 procedure

## 8.8

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.8] (1) Where the defendant contends that the Part 8 procedure should not be used because –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.8] (a) there is a substantial dispute of fact; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.8] (b) the use of the Part 8 procedure is not required or permitted by a rule or practice direction,

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.8] he must state his reasons when he files his acknowledgment of service.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.8] (Rule 8.5 requires a defendant who wishes to rely on written evidence to file it when he files his acknowledgment of service)

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.8] (2) When the court receives the acknowledgment of service and any written evidence it will give directions as to the future management of the case.

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.8] (Rule 8.1(3) allows the court to make an order that the claim continue as if the claimant had not used the Part 8 procedure)

## Modifications to the general rules

## 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (a) provision is made in this Part for the matters which must be stated in the claim form and the defendant is not required to file a defence and therefore –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (i) Part 16 (statements of case) does not apply;

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (ii) Part 15 (defence and reply) does not apply;

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (iii) any time limit in these Rules which prevents the parties from taking a step before a defence is filed does not apply;

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (iv) the requirement under rule 7.8 to serve on the defendant a form for defending the claim does not apply;

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (b) the claimant may not obtain judgment by request on an admission and therefore –

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (i) rule 14.2 does apply; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (ii) the requirement under rule 7.8 to serve on the defendant a form for admitting the claim does not apply; and

[PART 8 – ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CLAIMS > 8.9 Where the Part 8 procedure is followed –] (c) the claim shall be treated as allocated to the multi-track and therefore Part 26 does not apply.
